blocks.zh: 量測分析改善體系、不符合品管制與 CAPA 流程；版本對照附錄
blocks.en: Measurement, Analysis and Improvement System, Control of Nonconforming Product and the CAPA Process; Annexes Comparing Versions

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Clause 8 的量測分析改善架構：從回饋收集 → 投訴處理 → 法規通報 → 內部稽核 → 製程與產品監控的完整閉環
blocks.en: Master the measurement, analysis and improvement framework of Clause 8: the complete closed loop from feedback collection → complaint handling → regulatory reporting → internal audit → monitoring of processes and product

blocks.zh: 理解 8.2.2 投訴的廣義定義，及其與 8.2.3 法規通報義務之間的決策邏輯（不是所有投訴都需通報）
blocks.en: Understand the broad definition of a complaint in 8.2.2 and the decision logic linking it to the regulatory reporting obligation in 8.2.3 (not every complaint is reportable)

blocks.zh: 掌握 8.3 不符合品的四層管控架構（通則、交貨前、交貨後、返工），以及各層對風險評估的要求
blocks.en: Master the four-layer control framework for nonconforming product in 8.3 (general, actions in response to nonconforming product detected before delivery, after delivery, and rework), and the risk assessment requirements at each layer

blocks.zh: 理解 8.5.2 CAPA 的 7 步驟流程，並區分 ISO 13485 CAPA 與 ISO 9001 版本的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Understand the 7-step CAPA process of 8.5.2, and distinguish the key differences between the ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 versions of CAPA

blocks.zh: 掌握 Annex A 的 2016 年重大變更項目，及 Annex B 中 ISO 13485 與 ISO 9001:2015 結構對照的核心差異
blocks.en: Master the major 2016 changes listed in Annex A, and the core differences in structure between ISO 13485 and ISO 9001:2015 shown in Annex B

blocks.zh: Clause 8.1–8.2.1: 量測一般要求與回饋系統
blocks.en: Clause 8.1–8.2.1: General Requirements for Measurement and the Feedback System

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 概念解析：8.1 的三個目的 vs. ISO 9001 的四個目的
blocks.en: Concept: the three purposes of 8.1 vs. the four purposes of ISO 9001

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 的 8.1 列出三個目的，刻意省略了 ISO 9001 的第四個目的：「持續改善（continual improvement）」。
blocks.en: 8.1 of ISO 13485:2016 lists three purposes and deliberately omits the fourth purpose of ISO 9001: "continual improvement".

blocks.zh: 這不是疏漏，而是設計選擇。ISO 13485 用語是「maintain the effectiveness」（維持有效性），而非「continual improvement」（持續改善）。
blocks.en: This is not an oversight but a design choice. ISO 13485 uses the wording "maintain the effectiveness" rather than "continual improvement".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實務意義：
blocks.en: Practical meaning for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 不要求「每年一定要更好」——只要求體系有效運作、符合法規
blocks.en: ISO 13485 does not require getting better every year; it only requires that the system operate effectively and comply with regulations

blocks.zh: 這與 FDA QSR 21 CFR Part 820 的邏輯一致：重點是控制，不是不斷精進
blocks.en: This is consistent with the logic of FDA QSR 21 CFR Part 820: the emphasis is on control, not on constant refinement

blocks.zh: 在 EU MDR/IVDR 的 QMS 申請中，稽核員會查這個區別——不要在 QMS 文件中承諾「continual improvement」，除非你真的有量化指標支撐
blocks.en: In QMS applications under EU MDR/IVDR, auditors will check this distinction; do not commit to "continual improvement" in QMS documents unless you have quantitative indicators to support it

blocks.zh: 類比說明：8.2.1 回饋系統是「早期預警雷達」
blocks.en: Analogy: the 8.2.1 feedback system is an "early warning radar"

blocks.zh: 回饋系統不只是被動收集投訴，更是主動偵測市場信號的感測器。
blocks.en: A feedback system is not just a passive collector of complaints; it is a sensor that actively detects market signals.

blocks.zh: 把它想像成工廠的環境監控：不是等到有事故才知道問題，而是持續偵測溫度、濕度、微生物數據。8.2.1 的回饋系統對「市場中的裝置」做同樣的事。
blocks.en: Think of it as a factory's environmental monitoring: you do not wait for an incident to learn of a problem, but continuously detect temperature, humidity, and microbiological data. The feedback system of 8.2.1 does the same for devices on the market.

blocks.zh: 2016 版新增的關鍵要求：feedback 必須回饋到 風險管理流程（risk management process）——這直接連結 ISO 14971，形成「上市後監控 → 風險再評估 → 設計/製程更新」的閉環。
blocks.en: A key requirement added in the 2016 version: feedback must be fed into the risk management process. This links directly to ISO 14971, forming a closed loop of post-market surveillance → risk reassessment → design/process update.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CDMO 的回饋系統設計
blocks.en: Practical considerations: designing a feedback system at a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常不直接面對終端用戶，但仍需建立回饋系統。可以從以下渠道收集：
blocks.en: A CDMO usually does not deal directly with end users but still needs to establish a feedback system. Information can be collected from the following channels:

blocks.zh: 客戶（品牌製造商）轉發的市場投訴摘要
blocks.en: Summaries of market complaints forwarded by the customer (the brand owner/manufacturer)

blocks.zh: CDMO 自身的品質保留樣品穩定性數據（Post-release stability）
blocks.en: The CDMO's own stability data on retained quality samples (post-release stability)

blocks.zh: 客戶服務會議（Quarterly Business Review）中的品質議題
blocks.en: Quality issues raised in customer service meetings (Quarterly Business Review)

blocks.zh: 法規當局對客戶產品的問詢（CDMO 應要求客戶通知相關查詢）
blocks.en: Regulatory authority inquiries about the customer's product (the CDMO should require the customer to notify it of relevant inquiries)

blocks.zh: CDMO 執行的服務批次的再加工/報廢記錄
blocks.en: Rework/scrap records for the service batches the CDMO has run

blocks.zh: Clause 8.2.2: 投訴處理（Complaint Handling）
blocks.en: Clause 8.2.2: Complaint Handling

blocks.zh: 概念解析：「投訴」的廣義定義——Any Communication
blocks.en: Concept: the broad definition of a "complaint" - Any Communication

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的 complaint 定義極廣：任何書面、電子、或口頭溝通，只要聲稱（alleges）裝置在下列任一方面有缺陷：
blocks.en: The ISO 13485 definition of complaint is very broad: any written, electronic, or oral communication that alleges deficiencies related to the device in any of the following respects:

blocks.zh: 身份識別（identity）、品質（quality）、耐用性（durability）
blocks.en: identity, quality, durability

blocks.zh: 可靠性（reliability）、安全性（safety）、有效性（effectiveness）
blocks.en: reliability, safety, effectiveness

blocks.zh: 性能（performance）
blocks.en: performance

blocks.zh: 注意「alleges」這個詞：不需要投訴被證實為事實，只要有人聲稱有缺陷，就構成 complaint。即使最終調查發現是使用者操作錯誤，仍必須作為 complaint 記錄並完成調查流程。
blocks.en: Note the word "alleges": the complaint does not need to be proven true; as long as someone alleges a deficiency, it constitutes a complaint. Even if the investigation finally finds user error, it must still be recorded as a complaint and taken through the investigation process.

blocks.zh: Near miss 的挑戰：用戶回報「差一點就出問題」是否構成 complaint？ISO 13485 的回答是：如果溝通「聲稱」裝置有安全性或性能缺陷，即使事故未實際發生，也可能構成 complaint。
blocks.en: The near-miss challenge: does a user report that "something almost went wrong" constitute a complaint? The ISO 13485 answer: if the communication "alleges" a safety or performance deficiency in the device, it may constitute a complaint even if no incident actually occurred.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CDMO 的投訴處理架構
blocks.en: Practical considerations: complaint handling structure at a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 是「受委託製造商」，通常不是法規意義上的「製造商（legal manufacturer）」。但投訴處理程序仍必須建立，因為：
blocks.en: A CDMO is a contract manufacturer and is usually not the legal manufacturer in the regulatory sense. A complaint handling procedure must still be established, because:

blocks.zh: 客戶將市場投訴轉發給 CDMO 時，需要有接收和評估流程
blocks.en: When the customer forwards market complaints to the CDMO, a process for receiving and evaluating them is needed

blocks.zh: CDMO 收到的投訴須判斷是否與自身製造活動有關，若有關則必須調查
blocks.en: For complaints it receives, the CDMO must determine whether they relate to its own manufacturing activities and, if so, must investigate

blocks.zh: CDMO 的調查結果需反饋給客戶，納入客戶的整體投訴記錄
blocks.en: The CDMO's investigation results must be fed back to the customer and incorporated into the customer's overall complaint records

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 同時持有 CE 標記或 510(k)（即 legal manufacturer），則直接承擔通報義務
blocks.en: If the CDMO also holds a CE mark or 510(k) (that is, it is the legal manufacturer), it directly bears the reporting obligation

blocks.zh: 投訴 vs. 通報的決策流程
blocks.en: Decision process: complaint vs. reporting

blocks.zh: 收到投訴後，需要做兩個獨立判斷：
blocks.en: After a complaint is received, two independent judgments are needed:

blocks.zh: 重要：「已上市的裝置」不包括還在 CDMO 廠內的在製品。CDMO 移交給客戶（品牌製造商）後，如果客戶尚未出貨，通報義務由品牌製造商判斷，而非 CDMO。
blocks.en: Important: a "device that has been placed on the market" does not include work-in-process still within the CDMO's facility. After the CDMO hands over to the customer (the brand owner), if the customer has not yet shipped, the reporting obligation is judged by the brand owner, not by the CDMO.

blocks.zh: 即使不需通報，投訴記錄仍是強制的。「Records shall be maintained for each complaint received」是絕對要求。
blocks.en: Even when reporting is not required, the complaint record is still mandatory. "Records shall be maintained for each complaint received" is an absolute requirement.

blocks.zh: Clause 8.2.3: 向法規當局通報（Vigilance Reporting）
blocks.en: Clause 8.2.3: Reporting to Regulatory Authorities (Vigilance Reporting)

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 Vigilance 責任邊界
blocks.en: The boundary of a CDMO's vigilance responsibility

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：
blocks.en: Key distinction:

blocks.zh: Legal manufacturer（法規製造商）：直接承擔向法規當局通報的義務
blocks.en: Legal manufacturer: directly bears the obligation to report to regulatory authorities

blocks.zh: Contract manufacturer（合約製造商，即典型 CDMO）：沒有直接通報義務，但必須及時向客戶提供調查結果，以支援客戶的通報決策
blocks.en: Contract manufacturer (the typical CDMO): has no direct reporting obligation, but must promptly provide investigation results to the customer to support the customer's reporting decision

blocks.zh: 實務上，CDMO 的品質協議（Quality Agreement）中應明定：
blocks.en: In practice, the CDMO's Quality Agreement should specify:

blocks.zh: CDMO 收到相關投訴/事件通知後的回應時限（通常比法規時限短 5–10 天，留緩衝給客戶）
blocks.en: The CDMO's response time after receiving notice of a relevant complaint/event (usually 5–10 days shorter than the regulatory deadline, leaving a buffer for the customer)

blocks.zh: CDMO 提供的調查報告格式和最低內容要求
blocks.en: The format and minimum content requirements for investigation reports provided by the CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 是否需要核閱客戶提交法規當局的通報草稿
blocks.en: Whether the CDMO is required to review the customer's draft report before it is submitted to the regulatory authority

blocks.zh: 類比說明：Vigilance 是醫療體系的「強制通報」
blocks.en: Analogy: vigilance is the "mandatory reporting" of the healthcare system

blocks.zh: 就像醫師發現某些傳染病必須通報衛生主管機關一樣，醫療器材的嚴重事件也必須通報——不是因為組織選擇，而是法律義務。
blocks.en: Just as a physician who finds certain infectious diseases must report them to the public health authority, serious events involving medical devices must also be reported. This is not an organizational choice but a legal obligation.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的貢獻是建立「決策流程」：每一件投訴都必須過一遍「是否符合通報標準？」的篩選。這個篩選流程本身就是稽核員關注的重點——不是看通報了多少，而是看決策邏輯是否嚴謹、有記錄。
blocks.en: The contribution of ISO 13485 is to establish a decision process: every complaint must be screened against the question "does it meet the reporting criteria?" This screening process itself is what auditors focus on. They look not at how many reports were made but at whether the decision logic is rigorous and documented.

blocks.zh: 概念解析：Vigilance Reporting 的管轄差異
blocks.en: Concept: jurisdictional differences in vigilance reporting

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 的 8.2.3 刻意保持「jurisdiction-neutral」——它不規定具體時限，而是要求組織了解並遵從各地法規。主要市場的要求：
blocks.en: 8.2.3 of ISO 13485:2016 is deliberately kept "jurisdiction-neutral": it does not prescribe specific time limits but requires the organization to know and comply with local regulations. Requirements in the main markets:

blocks.zh: CDMO 面對多市場客戶時，程序文件需明確規定「如何判斷適用哪個市場的通報要求」——通常依據產品的目標市場（intended market）和品牌製造商的法規主體所在地。
blocks.en: When a CDMO serves customers in multiple markets, its procedure must clearly state how to determine which market's reporting requirements apply, usually based on the product's intended market and the location of the brand owner's regulatory entity.

blocks.zh: Clause 8.2.4–8.2.6: 內部稽核與製程/產品監控
blocks.en: Clause 8.2.4–8.2.6: Internal Audit and Monitoring of Processes and Product

blocks.zh: 8.2.4 內部稽核：「without undue delay」的意義
blocks.en: 8.2.4 Internal audit: the meaning of "without undue delay"

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 在 8.2.4 使用了「without undue delay」——這比 ISO 9001 的「within agreed timeframe」更嚴格。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 uses "without undue delay" in 8.2.4, which is stricter than the "within agreed timeframe" of ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 「Undue delay」代表：即使沒有事先約定時限，也不能以「等待計劃」或「資源不足」為由無限期拖延。這個語言直接鏡像 FDA 483 觀察的常見問題：CAPA 開單但數月未完成。
blocks.en: "Undue delay" means that even if no time limit was agreed in advance, action cannot be postponed indefinitely on the grounds of "waiting for the plan" or "insufficient resources". This wording directly mirrors a common problem in FDA 483 observations: CAPAs opened but not completed for months.

blocks.zh: 對稽核程序的建議：
blocks.en: Recommendations for the audit procedure:

blocks.zh: 每個 audit finding 都應在 30 天內有 initial response（不必完成，但要有計劃）
blocks.en: Every audit finding should have an initial response within 30 days (it need not be complete, but there must be a plan)

blocks.zh: 稽核報告應包含「計劃完成日期」，並由責任部門主管簽署確認
blocks.en: The audit report should include a "planned completion date", confirmed by signature of the responsible department head

blocks.zh: follow-up verification 的記錄是 ISO 13485 明文要求，不是選項
blocks.en: Records of follow-up verification are an explicit ISO 13485 requirement, not an option

blocks.zh: 8.2.6 的「誰授權放行」記錄要求
blocks.en: The record requirement of 8.2.6: who authorized release

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 明確要求放行記錄需記載「授權放行人員」身份。這不只是簽名問題，而是可追溯性要求：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 explicitly requires that release records document the identity of the person authorizing release. This is not merely a matter of signatures but a traceability requirement:

blocks.zh: 若產品事後發現不合格，稽查可以追溯到是哪位 QC/QA 人員授權放行
blocks.en: If the product is later found nonconforming, an inspection can trace which QC/QA person authorized the release

blocks.zh: FDA 的 21 CFR 820.80 有相同要求，且要求記錄到個人層次（non-generic）
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 820.80 has the same requirement and requires records at the individual level (non-generic)

blocks.zh: EU MDR Annex IX 對 QMS 的技術文件審查也包含此項驗證
blocks.en: The review of technical documentation for the QMS under EU MDR Annex IX also includes verification of this item

blocks.zh: 2016 版新增要求：記錄中還需識別用於量測的「測試設備」（identify the test equipment used）。這確保設備校驗記錄可以和放行決定連結。
blocks.en: A requirement added in the 2016 version: the record must also identify the test equipment used. This ensures that equipment calibration records can be linked to release decisions.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CDMO 的稽核計劃設計
blocks.en: Practical considerations: designing an audit program at a CDMO

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 要求稽核頻率依「風險」和「上次稽核結果」動態調整。CDMO 可用以下矩陣：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 requires that audit frequency be dynamically adjusted according to risk and the results of previous audits. A CDMO can use the following matrix:

blocks.zh: Clause 8.3: 不符合品管制（Control of Nonconforming Product）
blocks.en: Clause 8.3: Control of Nonconforming Product

blocks.zh: 8.3.3 交貨後不符合品 = Field Action 的法律框架
blocks.en: 8.3.3 Nonconforming product after delivery = the legal framework for field action

blocks.zh: 8.3.3 是整個 Clause 8 中「法律後果最重大」的條款。一旦觸發，可能涉及：
blocks.en: 8.3.3 is the clause with the most serious legal consequences in the whole of Clause 8. Once triggered, it may involve:

blocks.zh: Advisory Notice（諮詢通知）：通知客戶和用戶有潛在風險，建議預防措施——不必然是召回
blocks.en: Advisory Notice: notifies customers and users of a potential risk and recommends precautionary measures, not necessarily a recall

blocks.zh: Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA)：EU MDR 術語，包含召回、修正、警告
blocks.en: Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA): an EU MDR term covering recall, correction, and warning

blocks.zh: Recall：從市場收回產品——美國由 FDA 或企業自主發起
blocks.en: Recall: withdrawal of the product from the market, initiated in the US by the FDA or voluntarily by the company

blocks.zh: 風險分析決定了 action 的範疇：哪些批次受影響？受影響地區？嚴重程度是否需要強制停用？CDMO 在此必須快速提供批次記錄和製程數據，支援客戶的決策。
blocks.en: Risk analysis determines the scope of the action: which batches are affected? Which regions? Is the severity such that mandatory withdrawal from use is needed? The CDMO must quickly provide batch records and process data here to support the customer's decision.

blocks.zh: 8.3.4 返工：不是「修了就好」
blocks.en: 8.3.4 Rework: not just "fix it and it's fine"

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 對返工的要求遠比 ISO 9001 嚴格：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 is far stricter on rework than ISO 9001:

blocks.zh: 一般工業的思路：「品質不對 → 修理 → 再出貨」
blocks.en: General industry thinking: "quality is wrong → repair → ship again"

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的要求：「品質不對 → 先做風險評估（返工可能造成什麼新問題？）→ 寫返工程序 → 執行返工 → 重新驗收（re-inspect + re-test）→ 記錄所有步驟」
blocks.en: ISO 13485 requires: "quality is wrong → first do a risk assessment (what new problems could the rework cause?) → write a rework procedure → perform the rework → re-verify (re-inspect + re-test) → record all steps"

blocks.zh: 典型風險：無菌充填產品返工（重新過濾/重新充填）會影響無菌保證水準；注射裝置返工可能改變材料相容性。返工前的 ISO 14971 風險評估因此是強制要求。
blocks.en: Typical risk: reworking aseptically filled product (refiltering/refilling) affects the sterility assurance level; reworking an injection device may change material compatibility. An ISO 14971 risk assessment before rework is therefore mandatory.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CDMO 不符合品 SOP 的最低內容
blocks.en: Practical considerations: minimum content of a CDMO nonconforming product SOP

blocks.zh: 識別和隔離觸發條件（非自動歸類——需人工評估是否符合「nonconforming product」定義）
blocks.en: Triggers for identification and segregation (not automatic classification; a human assessment is needed to determine whether the definition of "nonconforming product" is met)

blocks.zh: 交貨前三種處置路徑（消除、讓步、報廢）的授權層級
blocks.en: Authorization levels for the three disposition paths before delivery (elimination, concession, scrap)

blocks.zh: 讓步記錄格式（授權人、理由、法規限制確認）
blocks.en: Concession record format (authorizer, rationale, confirmation of regulatory limits)

blocks.zh: 交貨後通報流程（客戶通知時限 + 法規當局通知決策矩陣）
blocks.en: Post-delivery notification process (customer notification time limit + decision matrix for notifying regulatory authorities)

blocks.zh: 返工決策觸發條件和返工前風險評估模板
blocks.en: Triggers for the rework decision and a pre-rework risk assessment template

blocks.zh: 返工後重新驗收的測試項目清單（≥ 原始放行測試）
blocks.en: List of tests for re-verification after rework (≥ the original release tests)

blocks.zh: 概念解析：8.3 的四層架構
blocks.en: Concept: the four-layer structure of 8.3

blocks.zh: 2016 版將 8.3 從一個整合條款拆分為四個子條款，清晰對應四種情境：
blocks.en: The 2016 version splits 8.3 from a single combined clause into four subclauses, clearly corresponding to four situations:

blocks.zh: 2016 版相比 2003 版的核心新增：將「讓步（concession）」和「諮詢通知（advisory notice）」的記錄要求明文化，以及強制返工前做風險分析。
blocks.en: The core additions of the 2016 version compared with 2003: the record requirements for concessions and advisory notices are made explicit, and a risk analysis before rework is mandatory.

blocks.zh: Clause 8.4: 數據分析（Analysis of Data）
blocks.en: Clause 8.4: Analysis of Data

blocks.zh: 概念解析：8.4 是「整合輸出」，不是「獨立活動」
blocks.en: Concept: 8.4 is an "integrating output", not a "standalone activity"

blocks.zh: 8.4 的六個輸入來源（a-f）並非新的額外工作——它們都已在 Clause 8 的其他部分被要求：
blocks.en: The six input sources of 8.4 (a-f) are not new additional work; all of them are already required elsewhere in Clause 8:

blocks.zh: 8.4 的新增要求（2016 版）：這些數據必須被整合分析，並輸入管理審查。這意味著不能各部門各自為政——需要有橫跨部門的「QMS 績效儀表板」或等效機制。
blocks.en: New requirement of 8.4 (2016 version): these data must be analyzed in an integrated way and fed into management review. This means departments cannot work in silos; a cross-functional "QMS performance dashboard" or equivalent mechanism is needed.

blocks.zh: 2016 版對「上市後監控（post-market surveillance）」的連結顯著強化——8.4 的分析結果直接影響風險管理文件（RMF）的更新週期。
blocks.en: The link to post-market surveillance is significantly strengthened in the 2016 version: the results of the 8.4 analysis directly affect the update cycle of the risk management file (RMF).

blocks.zh: 類比說明：8.4 是 QMS 的「健康檢查報告」
blocks.en: Analogy: 8.4 is the QMS "health check report"

blocks.zh: 把 8.4 想像成企業的年度健康檢查：不是看每一個單獨指標，而是看整體趨勢和各指標之間的關聯。
blocks.en: Think of 8.4 as a company's annual health check: you look not at each individual indicator but at the overall trend and the relationships among indicators.

blocks.zh: 例：投訴率上升 + 供應商 NCR 增加 + 特定製程能力指數下滑——三個孤立的數據放在一起，可能指向同一個根本原因（例如：關鍵原料品質變化）。
blocks.en: Example: a rising complaint rate + increasing supplier NCRs + a declining process capability index for a particular process: three isolated data points, taken together, may point to the same root cause (for example, a change in the quality of a critical raw material).

blocks.zh: 這正是 8.4 要求的：系統性分析，不是逐一回應個案。管理審查（5.6）接收 8.4 的輸出後，才能做出真正有效的資源分配決定。
blocks.en: This is exactly what 8.4 requires: systematic analysis, not responding to cases one by one. Only after management review (5.6) receives the output of 8.4 can it make truly effective resource allocation decisions.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：管理審查輸入的數據包設計
blocks.en: Practical considerations: designing the data package for management review

blocks.zh: 每次管理審查前，QA 應準備涵蓋以下的數據分析包：
blocks.en: Before each management review, QA should prepare a data analysis package covering the following:

blocks.zh: 投訴件數、分類趨勢圖（近 12 個月）
blocks.en: Number of complaints and classification trend chart (last 12 months)

blocks.zh: CAPA 開立 / 完成 / 逾期率
blocks.en: CAPA opened / completed / overdue rate

blocks.zh: 內部稽核缺失分類與修正狀態
blocks.en: Internal audit finding classification and correction status

blocks.zh: 主要供應商品質指標（交貨合格率、NCR 件數）
blocks.en: Quality indicators of major suppliers (incoming acceptance rate, number of NCRs)

blocks.zh: 製程能力指數趨勢（Cpk by critical parameter）
blocks.en: Process capability index trends (Cpk by critical parameter)

blocks.zh: 產品放行率與批次報廢趨勢
blocks.en: Product release rate and batch rejection trend

blocks.zh: 法規通報件數（如適用）
blocks.en: Number of regulatory reports (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Post-market surveillance 信號摘要（如適用）
blocks.en: Summary of post-market surveillance signals (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Clause 8.5: 改善、矯正措施與預防措施
blocks.en: Clause 8.5: Improvement, Corrective Action and Preventive Action

blocks.zh: 概念解析：ISO 13485 CAPA 七步驟流程
blocks.en: Concept: the seven-step ISO 13485 CAPA process

blocks.zh: 整合 8.5.2 的要求，可梳理出 ISO 13485 CAPA 的完整邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: Integrating the requirements of 8.5.2, the complete logical chain of ISO 13485 CAPA can be laid out:

blocks.zh:
① 判定（Determination）
   識別不符合項並評估是否需要開立 CAPA

② 調查（Investigation）
   收集事件資訊、範圍確認

③ 根本原因分析（Root Cause Analysis）
   使用 5-Why、Fishbone 等工具

④ 措施必要性評估（Evaluation of Need for Action）
   若根本原因不會復發，可記錄並關閉

⑤ 措施實施（Implementation）
   含文件更新、訓練、設備修改等

⑥ 有效性驗證（Effectiveness Review）
   措施實施後，確認問題未復發

⑦ 不良影響確認（Adverse Effect Check）
   確認 CA 不會影響安全性或法規合規性
blocks.en:
① Determination
   Identify the nonconformity and evaluate whether a CAPA needs to be opened

② Investigation
   Collect information on the event and confirm the scope

③ Root Cause Analysis
   Use tools such as 5-Why and Fishbone

④ Evaluation of Need for Action
   If the root cause will not recur, this can be documented and closed

⑤ Implementation
   Including document updates, training, equipment modifications, etc.

⑥ Effectiveness Review
   After the action is implemented, confirm the problem has not recurred

⑦ Adverse Effect Check
   Confirm that the CA does not affect safety or regulatory compliance

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 CAPA vs. ISO 9001 CAPA 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key differences between ISO 13485 CAPA and ISO 9001 CAPA

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 在兩個地方比 ISO 9001 更嚴格：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 is stricter than ISO 9001 in two places:

blocks.zh: 1. 不良影響確認（Adverse Effect Check）：ISO 13485 要求每個 CA/PA 都必須驗證「措施本身不會對產品安全性或法規要求產生不良影響」。這是 2016 版的新增要求，ISO 9001 沒有對應條款。
blocks.en: 1. Adverse Effect Check: ISO 13485 requires that every CA/PA be verified to ensure that "the action itself does not adversely affect the safety of the product or regulatory requirements". This is a new requirement in the 2016 version, with no corresponding clause in ISO 9001.

blocks.zh: 實例：CA 要求更換無菌充填機的關鍵密封件，更換後需要重新做密封完整性測試——這個 re-validation 動作就是「adverse effect check」的一部分。
blocks.en: Example: a CA requires replacing a critical seal on an aseptic filling machine; after the replacement, a container closure integrity test must be repeated. This revalidation step is part of the "adverse effect check".

blocks.zh: 2. 無效 CAPA 的再循環：如果有效性驗證顯示措施無效，必須重新進入 CAPA 流程（不能只是「close with note」）。FDA 483 觀察中最常見的 CAPA 缺失正是此項——measures taken but effectiveness not verified, or verified and found ineffective but not re-opened.
blocks.en: 2. Recycling of ineffective CAPAs: if the effectiveness review shows the action was ineffective, the CAPA process must be re-entered (it cannot simply be "closed with a note"). This is the most common CAPA deficiency in FDA 483 observations: measures taken but effectiveness not verified, or verified and found ineffective but not re-opened.

blocks.zh: CA vs. PA 的區別：回顧 vs. 前瞻
blocks.en: CA vs. PA: retrospective vs. forward-looking

blocks.zh:
Corrective Action（矯正措施）：
  觸發條件 → 已發生的不符合項
  目標    → 消除根本原因，防止復發
  資料來源 → 投訴、內稽缺失、偏差

Preventive Action（預防措施）：
  觸發條件 → 潛在風險（尚未發生）
  目標    → 在問題出現前消除原因
  資料來源 → 趨勢分析、風險評估、製程能力監控

區別重點：
  CA 是因為「已有問題」
  PA 是因為「看到了警示信號」

常見誤用：把 CA 寫成 PA
  例：投訴已發生 → 開立「預防措施」
  正確：應開立 CA（因為問題已發生）
  PA 是真正的前瞻性活動
blocks.en:
Corrective Action:
  Trigger          → a nonconformity that has already occurred
  Objective        → eliminate the root cause and prevent recurrence
  Data sources     → complaints, internal audit findings, deviations

Preventive Action:
  Trigger          → a potential risk (not yet occurred)
  Objective        → eliminate the cause before the problem appears
  Data sources     → trend analysis, risk assessment, process capability monitoring

Key distinction:
  CA is for "a problem that already exists"
  PA is for "a warning signal that has been seen"

Common misuse: writing a CA as a PA
  Example: a complaint has already occurred → a "preventive action" is opened
  Correct: a CA should be opened (because the problem has occurred)
  PA is a truly forward-looking activity

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CAPA 系統設計的 FDA/EU 稽查視角
blocks.en: Practical considerations: CAPA system design from the FDA/EU inspection perspective

blocks.zh: FDA Form 483 和 EU MDR NB 技術審查中，CAPA 系統是最常被觀察（cited）的領域。關鍵稽查問題：
blocks.en: In FDA Form 483 observations and EU MDR notified body technical reviews, the CAPA system is the most frequently cited area. Key inspection questions:

blocks.zh: CAPA 開立是否及時（within defined timeframe after event detection）？
blocks.en: Is the CAPA opened in a timely manner (within a defined timeframe after event detection)?

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析是否有方法論記錄（5-Why、Fishbone 等）？
blocks.en: Is the root cause analysis documented with a methodology (5-Why, Fishbone, etc.)?

blocks.zh: 有效性驗證的成功標準（success criteria）是否在措施實施前就定義？
blocks.en: Were the success criteria for the effectiveness review defined before the action was implemented?

blocks.zh: 措施的不良影響評估（adverse effect check）是否已記錄？
blocks.en: Has the adverse effect check of the action been documented?

blocks.zh: 無效的 CAPA 是否被重新開立，而非僅記錄「not effective」後關閉？
blocks.en: Are ineffective CAPAs re-opened, rather than just recorded as "not effective" and closed?

blocks.zh: CAPA 趨勢是否輸入管理審查和 8.4 數據分析？
blocks.en: Are CAPA trends fed into management review and the 8.4 data analysis?

blocks.zh: Annex A (Informative): ISO 13485:2003 vs. 2016 重大變更摘要
blocks.en: Annex A (Informative): ISO 13485:2003 vs. 2016 Summary of Major Changes

blocks.zh: Annex A — 主要 2016 版新增/修訂條款
blocks.en: Annex A - Main New/Revised Clauses in the 2016 Version

blocks.zh: 概念解析：2016 版的核心哲學轉變
blocks.en: Concept: the core philosophical shift of the 2016 version

blocks.zh: 2016 版相比 2003 版，反映了醫療器材監管生態的三大變化：
blocks.en: Compared with the 2003 version, the 2016 version reflects three major changes in the medical device regulatory landscape:

blocks.zh: 1. 更強的「器材特異性」：4.2.3 MDF、6.4.2 污染管制、7.5.7 無菌屏障系統——這些條款在 ISO 9001 完全沒有對應，是醫療器材製造的專屬要求。2003 版仍然大量依賴 ISO 9001 框架，2016 版開始建立獨立的器材特異性要求。
blocks.en: 1. Stronger device specificity: 4.2.3 MDF, 6.4.2 contamination control, 7.5.7 sterile barrier systems. These clauses have no counterpart at all in ISO 9001 and are requirements specific to medical device manufacturing. The 2003 version still relied heavily on the ISO 9001 framework; the 2016 version began to build independent device-specific requirements.

blocks.zh: 2. 更完整的「上市後閉環」：8.2.1（回饋）→ 8.2.2（投訴）→ 8.2.3（通報）的三連結，在 2003 版是分散或缺失的。2016 版將上市後監控的體系化要求明文化，與 EU MDR 和 FDA QMSR 的方向一致。
blocks.en: 2. A more complete post-market closed loop: the three-way link of 8.2.1 (feedback) → 8.2.2 (complaints) → 8.2.3 (reporting) was scattered or missing in the 2003 version. The 2016 version makes the systematic requirements for post-market surveillance explicit, in line with the direction of EU MDR and FDA QMSR.

blocks.zh: 3. 更清晰的「軟體和數位要求」：4.1.6 軟體驗證（CSV/CSA）的明確要求，反映了製藥/器材業對 IT 系統依賴度的顯著上升。
blocks.en: 3. Clearer software and digital requirements: the explicit requirement for software validation in 4.1.6 (CSV/CSA) reflects the markedly increased reliance of the pharmaceutical and device industries on IT systems.

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 醫療器材檔案（MDF）：2016 版最重要的新增條款之一
blocks.en: 4.2.3 Medical Device File (MDF): one of the most important new clauses in the 2016 version

blocks.zh: MDF 的概念來自 EU MDD/MDR 的「Technical File / Technical Documentation」，2016 版首次納入 ISO 13485 主文。MDF 的主要內容：
blocks.en: The MDF concept comes from the "Technical File / Technical Documentation" of the EU MDD/MDR and was first included in the main text of ISO 13485 in the 2016 version. The main contents of the MDF:

blocks.zh: 器材通用描述（general description）
blocks.en: General description of the device

blocks.zh: 預期用途（intended use）和使用目的
blocks.en: Intended use and purpose

blocks.zh: 標示和使用說明（labeling and IFU）
blocks.en: Labeling and IFU (instructions for use)

blocks.zh: 設計規格（design specifications）
blocks.en: Design specifications

blocks.zh: 製造規格（manufacturing specifications）
blocks.en: Manufacturing specifications

blocks.zh: 安全性和性能要求（safety and performance requirements）
blocks.en: Safety and performance requirements

blocks.zh: 風險管理記錄摘要（risk management）
blocks.en: Summary of risk management records

blocks.zh: 驗證和確效記錄摘要（V&V records）
blocks.en: Summary of verification and validation records (V&V records)

blocks.zh: MDF 是設計歷史文件（Design History File, DHF）的超集——DHF 記錄設計過程，MDF 記錄器材的整個生命週期。對 CDMO 的影響：如果 CDMO 承擔部分設計活動，需要貢獻到客戶的 MDF。
blocks.en: The MDF is a superset of the Design History File (DHF): the DHF records the design process, while the MDF records the entire life cycle of the device. Implication for a CDMO: if the CDMO undertakes some design activities, it needs to contribute to the customer's MDF.

blocks.zh: 6.4.2 污染管制：填補了 2003 版的重大空白
blocks.en: 6.4.2 Contamination control: filling a major gap in the 2003 version

blocks.zh: 2003 版對無菌器材的污染管制要求模糊，依賴其他標準（如 ISO 14644）引用。2016 版明確要求：
blocks.en: The 2003 version was vague on contamination control for sterile devices and relied on references to other standards (such as ISO 14644). The 2016 version explicitly requires:

blocks.zh: 對有微生物或微粒污染風險的無菌器材，必須建立書面污染管制計劃
blocks.en: For sterile devices at risk of microbial or particulate contamination, a documented contamination control plan must be established

blocks.zh: 計劃必須涵蓋：人員（更衣、行為）、設備（清潔/滅菌）、環境（監控）、流程（材料移入移出）
blocks.en: The plan must cover personnel (gowning, behavior), equipment (cleaning/sterilization), environment (monitoring), and processes (material transfer in and out)

blocks.zh: 對無菌充填 CDMO：6.4.2 直接對應 ISO 14644-1/2（潔淨室分級）和 EU GMP Annex 1（無菌製造）的要求，是技術審查（technical audit）的重點查核項目。
blocks.en: For an aseptic filling CDMO: 6.4.2 corresponds directly to the requirements of ISO 14644-1/2 (cleanroom classification) and EU GMP Annex 1 (sterile manufacturing), and is a key checkpoint in technical audits.

blocks.zh: Annex B (Informative): ISO 13485:2016 vs. ISO 9001:2015 結構對照與差異
blocks.en: Annex B (Informative): ISO 13485:2016 vs. ISO 9001:2015 Structural Comparison and Differences

blocks.zh: Annex B — 兩個標準的關鍵對照
blocks.en: Annex B - Key Comparisons Between the Two Standards

blocks.zh: Annex B 提供 ISO 13485:2016 與 ISO 9001:2015 的雙向對照表（Table B.1 和 B.2）。以下列出主要結構差異：
blocks.en: Annex B provides two-way correspondence tables between ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 (Tables B.1 and B.2). The main structural differences are listed below:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 有、ISO 9001 無的條款：
blocks.en: Clauses in ISO 13485 but not in ISO 9001:

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 有、ISO 13485 省略的概念：
blocks.en: Concepts in ISO 9001 omitted from ISO 13485:

blocks.zh: Continual improvement（持續改善）：ISO 9001 Ch.10；ISO 13485 僅要求「maintain effectiveness」
blocks.en: Continual improvement: ISO 9001 Ch.10; ISO 13485 only requires "maintain effectiveness"

blocks.zh: Risk-based thinking（風險為基礎的思考）：ISO 9001 全面納入；ISO 13485 的「風險」限定在「安全性或性能要求」範圍內
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking: fully incorporated in ISO 9001; "risk" in ISO 13485 is limited to the scope of "safety or performance requirements"

blocks.zh: Customer satisfaction（客戶滿意度）：ISO 9001 明確要求監控；ISO 13485 僅要求投訴處理，不要求客戶滿意度調查
blocks.en: Customer satisfaction: ISO 9001 explicitly requires monitoring; ISO 13485 only requires complaint handling and does not require customer satisfaction surveys

blocks.zh: Knowledge management（知識管理）：ISO 9001 7.1.6；ISO 13485 無直接對應條款
blocks.en: Knowledge management: ISO 9001 7.1.6; ISO 13485 has no directly corresponding clause

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 13485 保留了 8.5.3 Preventive Action？
blocks.en: Why did ISO 13485 retain 8.5.3 Preventive Action?

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 移除了獨立的 Preventive Action 條款，將其整合入「risk-based thinking」（6.1）的廣泛框架。ISO 13485:2016 選擇保留 8.5.3，原因：
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 removed the standalone Preventive Action clause and integrated it into the broad framework of "risk-based thinking" (6.1). ISO 13485:2016 chose to retain 8.5.3, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 醫療器材法規（FDA QSR 21 CFR 820.100、EU MDR Annex IX）明確要求「preventive action」作為 QMS 的獨立要素
blocks.en: Medical device regulations (FDA QSR 21 CFR 820.100, EU MDR Annex IX) explicitly require "preventive action" as a separate element of the QMS

blocks.zh: 稽核員（Notified Body、FDA 稽查員）仍習慣用「CAPA」（含 PA）框架審查記錄
blocks.en: Auditors (notified bodies, FDA investigators) are still accustomed to reviewing records within the "CAPA" framework (including PA)

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 的「風險」概念被刻意限縮，若取消獨立 PA 條款，可能留下「潛在問題識別」的空白
blocks.en: The concept of "risk" in ISO 13485 is deliberately narrowed; removing the standalone PA clause could leave a gap in the identification of potential problems

blocks.zh: 實務提示：同時持有 ISO 9001 和 ISO 13485 認證的組織，CAPA 程序中應明確說明如何同時符合兩個標準的要求——通常一套 CAPA 程序可以涵蓋，但需要在程序中交叉引用。
blocks.en: Practical tip: an organization certified to both ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 should state clearly in its CAPA procedure how it meets the requirements of both standards. Usually one CAPA procedure can cover both, but cross-references are needed within the procedure.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：ISO 13485 是「特許醫院」的管理標準
blocks.en: Analogy: ISO 13485 is the management standard of a "specialist hospital"

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 適合所有行業，就像「通用企業管理教科書」。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 suits all industries, like a "general business management textbook".

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 是為醫療器材業量身設計的，就像一本「特許醫院管理手冊」——它假設你的產品如果出問題，可能傷害或殺死病人。所以它不要求「每年更好」（持續改善），而是要求「始終安全可靠」（維持有效性）。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 is tailored for the medical device industry, like a "specialist hospital management manual": it assumes that if your product fails, it may harm or kill a patient. So it does not require "getting better every year" (continual improvement) but "always safe and reliable" (maintaining effectiveness).

blocks.zh: 這個差異解釋了為什麼 ISO 13485 文件化要求更具體（「documented procedure」多於「documented information」），以及為什麼 CA/PA 的有效性驗證是強制的——因為「我們已經改善了，但沒有驗證」在醫療器材領域是不可接受的。
blocks.en: This difference explains why the documentation requirements of ISO 13485 are more specific (more "documented procedure" than "documented information"), and why the effectiveness review of CA/PA is mandatory: "we have improved, but did not verify it" is unacceptable in the medical device field.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 認證對 CDMO 的戰略意義
blocks.en: The strategic significance of ISO 13485 certification for a CDMO

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 認證是醫療器材 CDMO 的「入場券」，但以下幾個面向決定了 CDMO 的競爭位置：
blocks.en: ISO 13485 certification is the "ticket of entry" for a medical device CDMO, but the following dimensions determine the CDMO's competitive position:

blocks.zh: 認證範圍（scope）：是「所有醫療器材」還是「特定類別」？範圍越廣，對客戶越有吸引力
blocks.en: Certification scope: "all medical devices" or "specific categories"? The broader the scope, the more attractive to customers

blocks.zh: 覆蓋的生命週期階段：僅製造，還是含設計服務？含設計服務的 CDMO 可協助客戶建立 7.3 設計控制體系
blocks.en: Life cycle stages covered: manufacturing only, or including design services? A CDMO that includes design services can help customers set up a 7.3 design control system

blocks.zh: 與 EU MDR/FDA QMSR 的整合度：ISO 13485 是 EU MDR QMS 的充分條件，但 FDA QMSR（2024 更新版）直接對齊 ISO 13485:2016——對美國 FDA 登記的器材，ISO 13485 認證具有直接的法規價值
blocks.en: Integration with EU MDR/FDA QMSR: ISO 13485 is a sufficient condition for the EU MDR QMS, and the FDA QMSR (2024 updated version) aligns directly with ISO 13485:2016, so for devices registered with the US FDA, ISO 13485 certification has direct regulatory value

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統的成熟度：客戶（品牌製造商）在選擇 CDMO 時，CAPA 系統的完整性和及時性是重要評估項目
blocks.en: Maturity of the CAPA system: when customers (brand owners) select a CDMO, the completeness and timeliness of its CAPA system are important evaluation items

blocks.zh: 概念解析：兩個標準的「設計哲學差異」
blocks.en: Concept: the "design philosophy differences" between the two standards

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 和 ISO 13485 雖然外形相似，但設計哲學不同：
blocks.en: Although ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 look similar, their design philosophies differ:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 Clause 8 + Annexes — 整體學習總結
blocks.en: ISO 13485:2016 Clause 8 + Annexes - Overall Learning Summary

blocks.zh: 量測閉環（8.1–8.2.6）：回饋 → 投訴 → 法規通報 → 稽核 → 製程監控 → 產品放行，每一步都有書面程序和記錄要求，形成完整的上市後監控閉環
blocks.en: The measurement closed loop (8.1–8.2.6): feedback → complaints → regulatory reporting → audit → process monitoring → product release; every step has documented procedure and record requirements, forming a complete post-market surveillance closed loop

blocks.zh: Complaint 的廣義定義：任何聲稱裝置有缺陷的書面/電子/口頭溝通都是 complaint；「已上市」是觸發 8.2.3 通報評估的前提條件
blocks.en: The broad definition of complaint: any written/electronic/oral communication alleging a deficiency in a device is a complaint; "placed on the market" is the prerequisite for triggering the 8.2.3 reporting assessment

blocks.zh: 不符合品四層架構（8.3.1–8.3.4）：交貨前→三種處置；交貨後→風險分析+召回/通報；返工→返工前風險評估+返工後重新驗收；每層都有獨立的記錄要求
blocks.en: The four-layer structure for nonconforming product (8.3.1–8.3.4): before delivery → three dispositions; after delivery → risk analysis + recall/reporting; rework → pre-rework risk assessment + post-rework re-verification; each layer has its own record requirements

blocks.zh: CAPA 七步驟：判定→調查→根本原因→措施必要性→實施→有效性驗證→不良影響確認；有效性驗證失敗必須重新開立，不可直接關閉
blocks.en: The seven CAPA steps: determination → investigation → root cause → evaluation of need for action → implementation → effectiveness review → adverse effect check; if the effectiveness review fails, the CAPA must be re-opened and cannot simply be closed

blocks.zh: 2016 版的醫療器材特異化：MDF（4.2.3）、污染管制（6.4.2）、無菌屏障驗證（7.5.7）、投訴處理（8.2.2）、法規通報（8.2.3）——這五個新增/強化條款將 ISO 13485 從「ISO 9001 的醫療器材版」轉化為「真正的醫療器材專屬標準」
blocks.en: Device specificity in the 2016 version: MDF (4.2.3), contamination control (6.4.2), sterile barrier validation (7.5.7), complaint handling (8.2.2), and regulatory reporting (8.2.3). These five new or strengthened clauses transform ISO 13485 from "the medical device version of ISO 9001" into "a truly device-specific standard"

blocks.zh: Annex B 差異的實務意義：ISO 13485 省略「持續改善」和「廣泛風險思維」，保留「預防措施」獨立條款——CAPA 程序需同時對應 FDA QSR、EU MDR Annex IX、ISO 13485 三套要求，並在程序中交叉引用
blocks.en: The practical significance of the Annex B differences: ISO 13485 omits "continual improvement" and "broad risk thinking" and retains the standalone "preventive action" clause; a CAPA procedure must address FDA QSR, EU MDR Annex IX, and ISO 13485 together, with cross-references within the procedure
